'''Carh'la Bastra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|A shipment that I am interested in has been acquired by three different groups. A Jawa trading party, Valarians and Darklighters.|Carh'la Bastra, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:StS" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Captain Carh'la Bastra was stationed in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where she recruited new members to join the Rebellion's cause.<ref name="SWG:StS" /> Her immediate superior was [[Special Agent/Legends|Special Agent]] [[Wilson Tchorshel]].<ref name="SWG:TN">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|To Naboo|Tatooine}}</ref> During that time, she worked closely with [[Droma Ordo]], another Rebel Alliance member in Anchorhead.<ref name="SWG:StS" /> She was also associated with the [[White Thranta Shipping Company]], a front for illegal activities of [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's criminal organization]].<ref name="SWG:DI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Digital Infection|Tatooine}}</ref> The company [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] most of its goods to the Rebellion.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|329|White Thranta}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Bastra was tasked with finding a cargo arrived recently from [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]]. The cargo was now lost among the various denizens on Tatooine and both Rebel and [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] were very interested in finding it. Fortunately, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] agreed to help Bastra, instead of Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arlan Barrezz|Barrezz]].<ref name="SWG:StS" />

Captain Bastra first tasked the spacer with finding the inventory of the cargo content that was acquired by a [[Sand Crawler 345|group]] of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] traders. The Jawas had recently been spotted at [[Tosche Station/Legends|Tosche Station]], near [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. There, the spacer learned from the manager [[Cuan Talon]] that he should ask his warehouse manager [[Janus]] but the latter had already been killed by [[Desert Demons]].<ref name="SWG:TS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Tosche Station|Tatooine}}</ref> From Janus' [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], the spacer recovered the first part of the cargo data and discovered that the Jawa had also visited the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]]. At the homestead, [[Zef Ando]] agreed to give the inventory of what he bought from the Jawas.<ref name="SWG:LH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Lars Homestead" on Tatooine</ref> The spacer finally reached the Jawa sandcrawler in the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]] but it was under attack from [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]. The spacer attacked the Tusken Raiders and rescued the Jawas and the droid [[FA-2PO]]. The spacer later recovered Jawa encryption keys from the Tusken Raiders and finally accessed to the sandcrawler database.<ref name="SWG:JT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Jawa Tracks|Tatooine}}</ref>

Bastra then tasked the spacer with going to the [[Valarian Depot]] near [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]]. It turned out that the [[Valarian Syndicate|Valarian]] crime syndicate acquired a portion of the lost cargo. Despite the number of guards patrolling the depot, the spacer did a complete inventory, by checking the manifests on the cargo pallets.<ref name="SWG:VH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Valarian Haul|Tatooine}}</ref> Bastra immediately tasked the spacer with going to the [[Darklighter family/Legends|Darklighter]] [[Darklighter cache|cache]] near their [[Darklighter estate|estate]] as it appeared that some of the cargo ended up in their hands. However, the Darklighter guard [[Draci]] informed the spacer that Desert Demon had overrun the cave. The spacer fought his way in the cache and managed to do a complete inventory.<ref name="SWG:DC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Darklighter Cache|Tatooine}}</ref>

Carh'la Bastra then requested the spacer to deliver the data to her [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]], [[Jem Lavar]]. The spacer had first to rescue Lavar from a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|gunrunners]]. Jem Lavar analyzed the inventory data from the Jawas, the Darklighter and the Valarians and finally discovered that the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]] that both the Empire and the Rebellion were looking for was bought by the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]].<ref name="SWG:RS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Rebel Spy|Tatooine}}</ref>

The spacer was tasked by Bastra to retrieve the droids and thus headed to [[Wald's Parts|Watto's Shop]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. There, the spacer learnt that the droids was already sold in spare parts. Nevertheless, Watto agreed to re-assemble the droid if the spacer was able to get all the parts.<ref name="SWG:WB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Watto's Bargain|Tatooine}}</ref> The spacer obtained the droid body from [[Ji'Ni Sil]] in the [[Jawa mountain fortress/Legends|Jawa Mountain Fortress]],<ref name="SWG:BB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Body Building" on Tatooine</ref> the legs from [[Syndil Na'Marr]] and a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] pilot,<ref name="SWG:LW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Leg Work" on Tatooine</ref> the [[Motivator/Legends|motivator]] from one of [[An'Kwee]]'s death [[Podracing/Legends|podracer]] pilot friend,<ref name="SWG:PR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Pod Retrieval" on Tatooine</ref> the motivator booster controller from [[Hilbrun|Pah]] and his gang,<ref name="SWG:RM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Repo Man" on Tatooine</ref> the diagnostic controller in the [[Squill Cave]],<ref name="SWG:SD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Squill Diving" on Tatooine</ref> and finally the head from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Supervisor droid/Legends|supervisor droid]] [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]].<ref name="SWG:TtH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Tracking the Head" on Tatooine</ref><ref name="SWG:R">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Runaways" on Tatooine</ref> When the spacer returned to the shop with all parts, Watto finally helped re-assemble the droid.<ref name="SWG:PiT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Putting it Together|Tatooine}}</ref> From the reassembled droid, the spacer was able to recover the information both the Empire and the Rebellion were looking for. Carh'la Bastra ordered the spacer to immediately transmit the data to Special Agent Tchorshel on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:TN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Carh'la Bastra was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:StS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Carh'la Bastra was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
